description: Compact and subterranean. Mining aptitude can't fall below B. Cave-dark speeds their hands, blows land lighter on a miner's build, and stoneform can still a killing blow; but water drags at them like a millstone.
strengths: Mining aptitude never falls below B
Cave-dark speeds hands; all damage lands lighter
Stoneform can still a killing blow
weaknesses: Water drags at you like a millstone
